market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $140 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month is around $104 on May 1 with brief geopolitical spike to ~$110 reported. To hit $140 (any 1-min candle high) requires a +35% move in 31 days. Even Iran-Strait of Hormuz risk premium has not produced anything near $140; would require a serious supply shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major Middle East escalation closing the Strait of Hormuz could spike prices unpredictably.
